title: secp256r1 (P-256) P256VERIFY Precompile for FEVM
description: This proposal introduces a new FEVM precompile for efficient ECDSA signature verification over the secp256r1 (P-256) elliptic curve, as specified by Ethereum’s EIP-7951. This enables practical verification of signatures produced by common secure hardware and standards such as WebAuthn/passkeys.

clients: Provides a simpler alternative to custom signature schemes for user authentication in FEVM dApps.
applicationDevelopers: Enables account abstraction patterns and authentication flows backed by passkeys and secure hardware.
Improves portability of applications and libraries that already target EIP-7951 / RIP-7212 style verification.
